jsesh.mdcDisplayer.draw
Class ViewDrawer

java.lang.Object
  jsesh.mdcDisplayer.draw.ViewDrawer
public class ViewDrawer
extends java.lang.Object

Knows how to draw a view and its subviews. A viewdrawer delegates the actual drawing of its elements to an ElementDrawer.

An important point is that in order to be able to use the VectorGraphics library, the following convention must be kept : when the current transformation for the graphic context must be modified, we shall do it this way : 

                         // save :
                         	Graphics2D tmpg= (Graphics2D)g.create();
                         ... work on tmpg, not g.
                          //restoration simply means using "g" again. 
                          //free the resource :
                          tmpg.dispose();
We used to save the current transform instead, but it doesn't work in VectorGraphics. This is documented in the class : org.freehep.graphics2d.VectorGraphics.

If it slows the system (which is not completely sure), a possible system would be to use "Saver" class, which would implement a memento design pattern for Graphics2D. The actual implementation would be one of these two. This file is free Software (c) Serge Rosmorduc

setShadeAfter

public void setShadeAfter(boolean shadeAfter)
If ShadeAfter is true, the shading should be drawn after the shaded elements. For systems which support transparency, shadeAfter at true might be a good choice. Older systems (in the present case, wmf), should use shadeAfter= false.

Parameters:
shadeAfter -
